name: @gjsify/recurrence
description: Read-only RFC 5545 recurrence expansion over ical.js: RRULE, RDATE, EXDATE, RECURRENCE-ID overrides, all-day runs, a per-series cap that reports what it cut, and a window cache keyed by uid + version + window. Resolves zones from the item's own VTIMEZONE, then the host's Intl; never guesses — an unresolvable TZID stays floating and says so. Plain ical.js, GJS and Node. Incubating in reminder; moves to gjsify unchanged.
